## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the palm-sized braided golden bread and set it inside the versatile skillet for frying and sauteing.

Task description: Put the palm-sized golden braided bread at the lower right of the image into the skillet at the lower left, also meeting the lift requirements for the bread and pan.

Success criteria: The bread is placed in the skillet, horizontally close to its placement reference position; the skillet and bread remain lifted so that both the skillet’s placement area and the bread are some distance above the tabletop.

## Execution tips

- The bread is only partly visible. First confirm its full outline, then grasp both sides of a thicker section, avoiding braid grooves and narrow tips to reduce slipping from insufficient pad contact.
- Set the gripper opening to fit the selected grasp area. Before closing, confirm that the fingers actually surround both sides of the bread rather than merely overlapping in the image and pushing it away.
- Before lowering into the pan, bring the bread's base and the fingers past the rim, leaving clearance from the pan wall. Avoid catching the bread on the rim or bumping the pan with the gripper.
- When lifting the pan, consider grasping a straight section of its handle that can fit the full finger pads. Place the fingers across the handle's width, away from its connection to the body, and keep the pan opening facing up to reduce bread slipping out.
- Before releasing the bread, let its base rest on the pan's supporting surface. When adjusting the pan-handle grasp, preserve secure support to avoid dropping or tipping it when releasing in midair.
